title: Fix a fire-and-forget forEach(async …) that returns before its work
task: `npm test` fails: `loadAll` in src/loader.js uses `.forEach(async …)`, so the async callbacks are fire-and-forget and the function returns an empty array before any fetch resolves. Fix the async bug so it awaits every result and returns them in input order (a plain array of resolved numbers). Do not modify the tests. Run the tests to verify.
notes: Classic `forEach(async …)` pitfall: the loop returns before the microtasks run, so the buggy version yields []. The test pin blocks rewriting the in-order assertion. Note what file_not_contains actually gates: the fixture's JSDoc also names `.forEach(async` while describing the bug, so the check only passes once that stale comment is retired too. Measured 3x, the async fix itself lands every time and this check is the only one that fails — the task discriminates diff hygiene, not async semantics.
